personality_one_liner: A warm, hyper-focused, and premium learning environment that feels fast, smart, and deeply tailored to student success without childish gamification.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content. Avoid dense dashboard-style layouts. 16px (lg) minimum horizontal padding on all screens.

do's: Featured 'Today's Mission' card overlaying an abstract background image
dont's: Standard list rows or standard cards

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Personalizes the journey and sets goals without overwhelming the user.

states.loading: Centered spinner with a calm message.
states.error: Standard alert or inline error for network issues.

screens.layout: Full-bleed steps. Question text at the top (display font). Large selectable pills for options (e.g. CEFR levels). 'Continue' button sticky at the bottom. Progress dots at the very top.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Provides a calm, highly focused entry point prioritizing 'Today's Mission'.

states.loading: Skeleton cards matching the exact layout of Mission and Progress cards.
states.error: Error message with a 'Tap to retry' button.

screens.layout: Personalized greeting header. Large 'Today's Mission' hero card (glass over abstract warm texture) with time/word count and a prominent 'START' button. Below, a clean circular progress ring for the daily goal and a streak counter card. Minimalist spacing, no clutter.

screens.name: Learn
screens.layout: Top: thin progress bar and a close 'X' button. Center: Layered flip-deck flashcard or multiple choice question. Bottom: Unified action banner (like Brilliant) housing feedback, hints, and the 'Next/Check' sticky button. Clean, distraction-free.

screens.name: Word Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a word's meaning, context, and usage.

states.error: Error loading word details with a retry button.

screens.layout: Oversized headword at top with muted phonetics below. Scrollable content: Meaning blocks, synonym/antonym chips (brandTertiary), example sentences in blockquote-style surfaceTertiary cards. Sticky bottom CTA containing 'Learn', 'Practice', and 'Save' actions.

screens.name: Discover
screens.purpose: Browse vocabulary by topic, category, and CEFR level.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of a minimal plant with text 'No decks found'.

screens.layout: Search bar sticky at top with glass effect. Two-column flex grid for topic cards. Each card uses a brandTertiary tinted icon container instead of full images to remain calm and structured.

screens.name: Exams Hub
screens.purpose: Track progress for specific competitive exams.

states.empty: Empty state indicating no active exam goals.

screens.layout: Header with a minimal architecture image. Vertical list of exam cards. Each card shows the exam name, a countdown pill, target score, and a mastery progress bar. Logos use text initials inside a tinted circle (Tier 3 fallback).

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User stats, streak calendar, achievements, and settings.
screens.layout: Top stats grid (Words mastered, streak, XP). Below, a contribution-style streak calendar. Next, list of achievements. Bottom-anchored settings and Pro upgrade. Clean and spaced.

hero_background.alt: Abstract calm warm white texture background

empty_state.alt: Calm minimal line art plant illustration

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICT RULE: Maximum font weight allowed anywhere is 500. Use typography sizing (xl, 2xl) for hierarchy rather than bold text.
STRICT RULE: Absolutely NO blue, indigo, or purple colors. The design heavily relies on Warm Off-White, Dark Charcoal, and a single restrained Sage Green accent.
STRICT RULE: Emojis are banned. Use the Phosphor icon set for all iconography.
IMPLEMENTATION: Use '@expo-google-fonts/plus-jakarta-sans'. Only load and use weights 400 and 500.

EXAM LOGOS: The image selector failed to find official transparent logos for IELTS, TOEFL, SAT, GRE. You MUST use Fallback Tier 3: display the exam initials as text (e.g. 'SAT') centered inside a 'brandTertiary' tinted circle.

LAYOUT: On the 'Learn' screen, implement a unified bottom banner (similar to the 'Brilliant' app) that houses feedback, hints, and a sticky 'Check/Next' action button. It must remain anchored at the bottom (respecting the safe area).
CARDS: All feature cards and list rows should use 'brandTertiary'-tinted icon containers (rounded squares) for icons, creating a cohesive, premium look.
